description: Delete many recent messages at once (2 to 100), optionally filtered by author or text. Discord cannot bulk delete messages older than 14 days. Safe to call directly: the first call returns the exact list it would remove plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token deletes them.

contains.description: Only delete messages containing this text.

count.description: How many recent messages to scan. Default 50.

from_author.description: Only delete messages whose author name matches this.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: bulk_delete_messages
title: Bulk delete messages
